title: Garlicky Fennel Skillet Delight
description: A flavorful skillet dish made with fennel and a hint of garlic, perfect for a quick weeknight dinner.
instructions: Heat the skillet over medium-high heat.
Add 2 tablespoons of oil and sauté the fennel and garlic until tender, about 5 minutes.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Optional: Add the zesty for an extra kick.
Cook time will vary slightly based on skillet size and heat distribution
Note: Cooking times listed are approximate and can vary based on individual factors
